description.zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为[CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~)返回的任务**ID**。也可通过[ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the [CreateDeploymentJob](~~2712234~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the **JobId** parameter. You can also call the [ListDeploymentJob](~~2712223~~) operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task.

The desired status.

Valid values:

*   rollback

description.zh: 部署任务Worker ID。此处ID可通过[ListWorkerResource](~~2712224~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the worker task. You can call the [ListWorkerResource](~~2712224~~) operation to obtain the ID of a worker task.
